_doc: T-379 server-side movement collision barriers. Coarse blocker-volume set (the ticket's 'buildings/walls before full navmesh' tier) fed to movement_collision.gd and tested against every request_move segment on the intake path. Each barrier is a set of impassable WALL SEGMENTS in server planar coords (x, z) == PlayerSessions pos (x, y); a move whose from->to segment crosses any wall segment is rejected server-side (noclip defense). Door/gate openings are the GAPS between segments, so legitimate traversal through them crosses no segment and passes. SYSTEMS-LANE MIRROR (like terrain_field.gd mirrors WorldView): the Highkeep ring is copied from client/assets/highkeep_plan.json 'wall' (the visual lane owns that source); keep this in sync when the ring changes. Extend with more polylines/rects as the visual lane supplies footprints; seed deliberately small so legitimate play never false-positives.

barriers.name: highkeep_curtain_wall
barriers._source: client/assets/highkeep_plan.json wall.polyline — OPEN ring: the gap between the last and first vertex (x=8..-8 at z=-140) is the north gate (gate.pos [0,-140], width 8), so a move through the gate crosses no wall segment.
